description: A long concluding history of the 1994 film, SG-1 across 1997–2007, changing cast, television craft, humor, moral blind spots, rising Earth power and the 2008 films.

related_resources.reason: Contemporaneous history of Wright and Glassner’s adaptation and MGM commission.
The development of SG-1, casting and creative history during its production.
Early ethical encounter that complicates Earth’s expectations.

Jack, Ancient knowledge and the Asgard’s view of humanity’s future.
The time-loop episode’s comic structure and grief.
Documentary approach to loss and the significance of the SGC medical staff.
Cinematic conclusion to a major middle-period Earth-defense arc.
Crew time dilation and the regular television ending.
The Ori war’s ultimate conclusion in the 2008 film.
Final 2008 follow-up film and historical reset.
Two complementary movies with different creative goals.
Cooper’s discussion of the Ark’s coercive dilemma.
Production-design and producer recollections of the original pilot.
